question: In July 2023, the District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) in Tirupathur district, Tamil Nadu, achieved a monumental achievement by constructing 1546 farm ponds in just 30 days, setting a new world record. This remarkable initiative was carried out under which government scheme?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In July 2023, the District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) of Tirupathur district, Tamil Nadu, constructed **1546 farm ponds in just 30 days**, setting a new world record.
 
• This initiative was carried out under the **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)**, a flagship government program.
 
• MGNREGS aims to provide guaranteed wage employment to rural households and promote sustainable rural development projects such as **water conservation and management.**
 
• The construction of farm ponds under this scheme **enhances water availability** for agriculture and helps mitigate the adverse effects of drought.
 
• This achievement reflects the dual objective of MGNREGS to **generate rural employment and create durable assets** that improve infrastructure and resilience to climate change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)**

 
 
• Launched in 2005, it is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India.
 
• It provides a legal guarantee of **100 days of wage employment** per financial year to every rural household.
 
• The scheme primarily focuses on **labor-intensive works** such as water conservation, drought-proofing, irrigation, and land development.
 
• MGNREGS is a demand-driven program, meaning work is provided based on the needs of rural households.
 
 
 
• **Farm Ponds**
 
 
• Farm ponds are small water storage structures built to collect and store surface runoff or rainwater.
 
• They play a crucial role in **addressing water scarcity** and ensuring year-round irrigation for agriculture.
 
• Farm ponds help in **groundwater recharge**, reduce soil erosion, and support sustainable farming practices.
 
• They are particularly beneficial in **drought-prone regions** to combat climate variability.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) Alignment**
 
 
• MGNREGS supports SDG 1 (**No Poverty**) through rural employment generation.
 
• Farm ponds contribute to SDG 6 (**Clean Water and Sanitation**) by enhancing water availability for agriculture.
 
• The scheme also aligns with SDG 13 (**Climate Action**) by improving resilience against climate change.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Water Conservation**
 
 
• Water conservation is essential for ensuring agricultural productivity, especially in rain-fed regions.
 
• Efficient water management practices, such as farm ponds, help in **mitigating climate change** impacts and ensuring food security.
 
• Such initiatives contribute to maintaining ecological balance and preventing resource depletion in rural areas.
